programme.title: 海猎人 #5
programme.desc: 在好望角十字角炙热的阳光下,大批海豹群聚于纳米比亚骷髅海岸。雄性海豹体重可达 360 公斤,巡守领域以保护雌性与幼崽。然而,新的陆地掠食者正逼近,迫使牠们学习全新的防御行为。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #6
programme.desc: 从出生起就充满了风险和回报。动物为了成年必须不断克服难以置信的障碍。牠们必须学习觅食、保护家园、吸引配偶、养儿育女,心心念念一件事──生存下去。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #7
programme.desc: 从在树枝上寻找配偶,到适应高处生活,树栖动物进化出独有的特征,以确保牠们在这恶劣又复杂的环境茁壮成长。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #8
programme.desc: 猎物们利用巧妙的适应力和狡猾的技巧,进化出难以置信的技巧来逃避死亡。

programme.title: 进化中的素食者 #1
programme.desc: 文拿与朋友莉莉星和萝拉马拉诺一起串餐厅,沉浸在植物性饮食中,法式糕点、五香「牛肉」炸角、泰式「鸡」翼和烧「牛扒」。

programme.title: 进化中的素食者 #2
programme.desc: 多元化的大厨们制作垂涎欲滴的素饺子、炸「鸡」三文治和越南「鲇鱼」;文拿寻找龙虾蘑菇并参观美国最古老的豆腐厂。

programme.title: 进化中的素食者 #3
programme.desc: 文拿探索他加拿大的「后院」,发现美味的素寿司、开心果奶油甜馅煎饼卷和薄饼;他与喜剧演员巴森尤瑟夫一起在一家素芝士厂试工。

programme.title: 成名之旅 #6
programme.desc: 专访阿诺史瓦辛格《 蒸发密令》导演漆黑罗素、《霸王神剑》共同主演莎拉道格拉斯​​、《大力神在纽约》导演阿瑟艾伦赛道曼等人。

programme.title: 成名之旅 #5
programme.desc: 专访妮可基嫚的演技教练苏珊伯臣、《不惜一切》监制庄拿汾塔别林、声学导师玛莉锡查干等人。

programme.title: 成名之旅 #4
programme.desc: 专访雪儿《施活的遭遇》导演米高候斯曼、神尼及雪儿经理哈维克斯基、影评人柯克恳尼咳等。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 罗莽湖 #4
programme.desc: 冬天温和潮湿,对不同动物来说,是好消息,也可以是坏消息。欧洲马鹿被逼移到更高的地方,三文鱼已经半年没有食物,山兔变成了显眼的白色,松鼠将自己的幼崽赶出巢穴。

programme.title: 蜥蜴的生存之道
programme.desc: 认识科学家们认为是生命及如何进化的故事的关键生物: 安乐蜥。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #1
programme.desc: 本集讲述了这些雄伟的座头鲸的旅程,从觅食地到繁殖地,母鲸与幼鲸之间的温柔时光,以及幼鲸在最初几个月面临的危险,包括与食肉鲸的惊人互动。座头鲸还面临着一个充满人类威胁的世界,从大型集装箱船到寻找石油和天然气时地震测试的影响,现在这些威胁再次威胁到它们的生存。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #2
programme.desc: 腔棘鱼通常被称为恐龙鱼,在化石记录中占有独特的地位,近一个世纪前重新发现它时震惊了科学界。我们跟随它的旅程直到今天,陪同 WildOceans 的科学家进行探险,以揭开它们更多的秘密和行为。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #3
programme.desc: 在《两条鲨鱼的故事》中,我们将看看南非海岸发现的各种各样的鲨鱼,重点关注濒临灭绝的路氏双髻鲨和标志性的大白鲨。

programme.title: 下一站: 中国云南 #1
programme.desc: 《下一站: 中国云南》将带领观众欣赏云南一些最美、最壮观的风景,那是约6,000种植物、200种哺乳类动物和500种鸟类的家。

programme.title: 维修的奥秘 2 #6
programme.desc: 米克大卫臣加入世上最极端、最容易发生雪崩的滑雪山之一- 雪鸟的团队。他们使用铲子、压雪车,甚至二战的榴弹砲,奋力保卫陡峭斜坡的安全。

programme.title: 维修的奥秘 2 #7
programme.desc: 米克大卫臣前往世上最大的自动化包裹分类设施 - 位于肯塔基州路易维尔的联合包裹服务公司世界港。每天有200万个包裹途经这里,全靠幕后一班戴著安全帽的英雄实现这一切。

programme.title: 维修的奥秘 2 #8
programme.desc: 米克大卫臣在费城的街道、隧道、轨道和电车修车库中与团队并肩合作,使美国最大、最古老的大众交通系统之一畅顺并准时运作。

programme.title: 非洲的空中历险 #5
programme.desc: 要观察这片充满地质现象的土地,只能从高空欣赏其雄伟的真面貌。从散布在海岸线上被遗忘的沉船到卡奥科兰无解的仙女圈,纳米比亚的秘密将被揭开。

programme.title: 非洲的空中历险 #6
programme.desc: 在丰富多彩的非洲国家-尚比亚上空翱翔。包括世上最富有的人所打造的城市和挤满世上最贫穷的人的市场。

programme.title: 海猎人 #6
programme.desc: 在巴塔哥尼亚瓦尔德斯半岛的中心,鲸鱼经常遭到一种体型娇小却意图凶残的掠食者袭击——海鸥。牠们迫使鲸鱼潜入深海,远离赖以生存的氧气与光线。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 罗莽湖 #4
programme.desc: 冬天温和潮湿,对不同动物来说,是好消息,也可以是坏消息。欧洲马鹿被逼移到更高的地方,三文鱼已经半年没有食物,山兔变成了显眼的白色,松鼠将自己的幼崽赶出巢穴。

programme.title: 蜥蜴的生存之道
programme.desc: 认识科学家们认为是生命及如何进化的故事的关键生物: 安乐蜥。

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South AmericaThey have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes

Pocket sized pets are currently all the rage, but there are details you need to pay attention to when raising them For example, hedgehogs are highly defensive, timid sugar gliders will harm themselves without being next to their owners, and cute guinea pigs like Norman from the movie "The Secret Life of Pets" are easily abandoned due to being easy to obtain and raise, etc Don't worry, experts will teach you how to raise them! Come to a restaurant in Kaohsiung to get up close with Rocket Raccoon from “The Avengers”!

programme.desc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners Their large size is one of their features Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets

programme.title: 机动战士高达 水星的魔女 SEASON2 #23
programme.desc: 驾驶异灵钢弹,苏莱塔与艾利克特对峙。载着米奥莉奈和其他人的火箭进入安静的零度。

programme.title: 和山田谈场LV999的恋爱 #1
programme.desc: 女大生木之下茜遭遇了一场突如其来的悲剧--她被男友甩掉,理由是他喜欢上在网路游戏「救世主之森(FOS)」认识的女生。茜在FOS里靠攻击弱小角色发泄情绪,并遇见同属一个公会的山田。茜不经意间向他倾诉与恋人分手的事,导致大大改变了她的人生。

programme.title: 和山田谈场LV999的恋爱 #2
programme.desc: 在FOS的线下活动中茜偶然发现山田的身影。然而在与前男友碰面时,茜一时冲动,将山田介绍为自己的男朋友。后来茜喝得烂醉如泥,被山田带到家中照顾。不小心弄丢饰品的茜为了寻回失物而在游戏里联络山田,结果不但被他冷淡对待,还被批评不会使用武器库。

programme.title: 和山田谈场LV999的恋爱 #3
programme.desc: 茜登入FOS后,发现公会会长琉璃姬与山田也在线。虽然山田平时就像他的「能面」角色一样冷淡,但他对琉璃姬却一直表现得很亲近,这让茜怀疑他们其实是情侣关系,她逐渐意识到自己对山田的情感。之后茜收到了琉璃姬的线下聚会邀请,并答应见面。

programme.title: 久保同学不放过我 #11
programme.desc: 喜欢的漫画翻拍而成的电影将在周五上映,曾被白石同学推荐看这部漫画的久保同学借机邀他去看电影。当天和打扮可爱且绑著马尾的久保同学前往电影院的白石同学因存在感薄弱而被人忽视,身旁的久保同学被男生搭讪后显得一脸困扰,白石同学将有何反应?

programme.title: 久保同学不放过我 #12
programme.desc: 白石同学在4月25日迎来生日,像往常不被人祝贺的他完全没有主角该有的样子。不过他肚子却大声咕咕叫,意外受到同学瞩目。久保同学知道他很饿后将巧克力交给感到难为情的白石同学,包装上写著祝福他生日的话语。她总是关注著白石同学的原因究竟为何?

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守护者 #1
programme.desc: 乙木守仁是拥有鬼之力量的少年。某天,结束魔女修行的青梅竹马妮可回到了守仁身边!根据古老的盟约,守仁将与妮可住在同一个屋簷下。面对「冒失女孩」妮可引发的各种麻烦,守仁能否坚持从预言的灾难中保护妮可呢?妮可与守仁的魔法恋爱喜剧现在揭开序幕!

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守护者 #2
programme.desc: 妮可和守仁「前途多灾多难」的同居生活开始了。而且还有更进一步的灾难在等待著守仁。没错,他和妮可一起进入私立翌桧高中。分到同一个班后,守仁再三叮咛妮可一定要隐瞒自己魔女的身分。妮可想用魔法偷偷帮助守仁,却不小心在全班同学面前使出了魔法……

programme.title: 愚蠢天使与恶魔共舞 #9
programme.desc: 莉莉的素体「莉莉亚」突然来到学校上课。由于她说她是以姊姊的身分,代替因感冒而缺席的莉莉来上课的,学校便特别允许了这件事。在课堂上不时找碴的莉莉亚让阿久津越来越警戒。然而午休时,莉莉亚却突然把阿久津叫了出去。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使与恶魔共舞 #10
programme.desc: 莉莉的哥哥「扎维」突然出现在阿久津和莉莉面前。阿久津被他那绅士风度般的态度当中所隐含的某种令人生畏的气息给震撼,莉莉则是丢下他和扎维一同离去。阿久津很在意莉莉离去时那不自然的笑容,当他追上他们两人时,他看到因为被扎维拿刀指著而吓得浑身发抖的莉莉。

programme.title: 海贼王 #19
programme.desc: 为了营救艾斯,白胡子海贼团与海军本部、七武海在马林福特爆发激战,而鲁夫也率领越狱犯加入战场。鲁夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯却为了保护他而被赤犬击杀,白胡子亦战死。战争最终在红发杰克的介入下落幕。经此一战,鲁夫与伙伴们决定分别修行两年后再会。

programme.title: 虚构推理 (第二季) #9
programme.desc: 刚一出了一道课题,要家人说明自己在二十三年前杀害妻子澄的真相,谁能做出最合理的解释,便能得到优先继承财产的权利。他的亲属纷纷试图解开课题,琴子却突然提出一个问题。为何刚一的小孩恰好都有不在场证明?之后事态迎来意外的发展。

programme.title: 虚构推理 (第二季) #10
programme.desc: 音无莉音与亮马回顾遭杀害的澄度过的一生。澄总是遵从父亲音无传次郎决定的方针,献上自己的人生促进集团发展。不料那套成功法则却不持久,本来被逼到崩毁边缘的集团因为澄的命案得以脱离危机。莉音分析事情原委后,宣称自己可能得知了事件真相。

programme.title: 虚构推理 (第二季) #11
programme.desc: 音无刚一认同了莉音得出的答案。不过琴子却加以否定,笃定地断言澄并非是因自杀而死,真凶另有其人!其实她掌握著从妖狐那里打听来且尚未公开的「某个重大真相」。真正的凶手究竟是谁?

programme.desc: 女大生木之下茜遭遇了一场突如其来的悲剧--她被男友甩掉,理由是他喜欢上在网路游戏「救世主之森(FOS)」认识的女生。茜在FOS里靠攻击弱小角色发泄情绪,并遇见同属一个公会的山田。茜不经意间向他倾诉与恋人分手的事,导致大大改变了她的人生。

programme.title: 和山田谈场LV999的恋爱 #2
programme.desc: 在FOS的线下活动中茜偶然发现山田的身影。然而在与前男友碰面时,茜一时冲动,将山田介绍为自己的男朋友。后来茜喝得烂醉如泥,被山田带到家中照顾。不小心弄丢饰品的茜为了寻回失物而在游戏里联络山田,结果不但被他冷淡对待,还被批评不会使用武器库。

programme.title: 和山田谈场LV999的恋爱 #3
programme.desc: 茜登入FOS后,发现公会会长琉璃姬与山田也在线。虽然山田平时就像他的「能面」角色一样冷淡,但他对琉璃姬却一直表现得很亲近,这让茜怀疑他们其实是情侣关系,她逐渐意识到自己对山田的情感。之后茜收到了琉璃姬的线下聚会邀请,并答应见面。

programme.title: 排球少年 (第二季) #21
programme.desc: 乌野高中发现京谷犯的失误与他为青叶城西高中做的进攻一样多。

programme.title: 排球少年 (第二季) #22
programme.desc: 山口被替换上场,且他的发球让乌野高中的得分超越了青叶城西高中。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使与恶魔共舞 #9
programme.desc: 莉莉的素体「莉莉亚」突然来到学校上课。由于她说她是以姊姊的身分,代替因感冒而缺席的莉莉来上课的,学校便特别允许了这件事。在课堂上不时找碴的莉莉亚让阿久津越来越警戒。然而午休时,莉莉亚却突然把阿久津叫了出去。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使与恶魔共舞 #10
programme.desc: 莉莉的哥哥「扎维」突然出现在阿久津和莉莉面前。阿久津被他那绅士风度般的态度当中所隐含的某种令人生畏的气息给震撼,莉莉则是丢下他和扎维一同离去。阿久津很在意莉莉离去时那不自然的笑容,当他追上他们两人时,他看到因为被扎维拿刀指著而吓得浑身发抖的莉莉。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守护者 #1
programme.desc: 乙木守仁是拥有鬼之力量的少年。某天,结束魔女修行的青梅竹马妮可回到了守仁身边!根据古老的盟约,守仁将与妮可住在同一个屋簷下。面对「冒失女孩」妮可引发的各种麻烦,守仁能否坚持从预言的灾难中保护妮可呢?妮可与守仁的魔法恋爱喜剧现在揭开序幕!

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守护者 #2
programme.desc: 妮可和守仁「前途多灾多难」的同居生活开始了。而且还有更进一步的灾难在等待著守仁。没错,他和妮可一起进入私立翌桧高中。分到同一个班后,守仁再三叮咛妮可一定要隐瞒自己魔女的身分。妮可想用魔法偷偷帮助守仁,却不小心在全班同学面前使出了魔法……

programme.title: 虚构推理 (第二季) #10
programme.desc: 音无莉音与亮马回顾遭杀害的澄度过的一生。澄总是遵从父亲音无传次郎决定的方针,献上自己的人生促进集团发展。不料那套成功法则却不持久,本来被逼到崩毁边缘的集团因为澄的命案得以脱离危机。莉音分析事情原委后,宣称自己可能得知了事件真相。

programme.title: 虚构推理 (第二季) #11
programme.desc: 音无刚一认同了莉音得出的答案。不过琴子却加以否定,笃定地断言澄并非是因自杀而死,真凶另有其人!其实她掌握著从妖狐那里打听来且尚未公开的「某个重大真相」。真正的凶手究竟是谁?

programme.title: 排球少年 (第二季) #22
programme.desc: 山口被替换上场,且他的发球让乌野高中的得分超越了青叶城西高中。

programme.title: 排球少年 (第二季) #23
programme.desc: 在最后一局中,乌野高中的分数领先青叶城西高中。他们有办法稳住阵脚并取得胜利吗?

programme.title: 和山田谈场LV999的恋爱 #3
programme.desc: 茜登入FOS后,发现公会会长琉璃姬与山田也在线。虽然山田平时就像他的「能面」角色一样冷淡,但他对琉璃姬却一直表现得很亲近,这让茜怀疑他们其实是情侣关系,她逐渐意识到自己对山田的情感。之后茜收到了琉璃姬的线下聚会邀请,并答应见面。

programme.title: 和山田谈场LV999的恋爱 #4
programme.desc: 茜参加了在FOS联名咖啡厅举办的公会线下聚会。虽然她认出山田与疑似是琉璃姬的两人,但对于现场出现的两位男性──瑛太与鸭田却完全没印象。在自我介绍时,鸭田自称是在FOS中名叫takezo的草莓农夫。而另一位瑛太则是茜万万没想到的某位玩家。

programme.title: 海贼王 #21
programme.desc: 为了营救艾斯,白胡子海贼团与海军本部、七武海在马林福特爆发激战,而鲁夫也率领越狱犯加入战场。鲁夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯却为了保护他而被赤犬击杀,白胡子亦战死。战争最终在红发杰克的介入下落幕。经此一战,鲁夫与伙伴们决定分别修行两年后再会。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #9
programme.desc: 莱利娜为了圣火仪式被赋予了严苛任务,疲惫不已的她来到泉水边,也因此救起了一只溺水的鸟。但刚好在场的大神官希卡认为去救注定要死的鸟只是白费功夫,两人因此起了口角。希卡事后遍寻整个神殿,却怎么都找不到那个对自己失礼,但又令人在意不已的莱利娜。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #10
programme.desc: 希卡看中莱利娜的才能,为了收她为徒而拚尽全力。他不仅打开了那道鲜少开启,通往神圣国的大门,召唤出圣骑士团,以展现大神官的威严,甚至还为了表现亲和力,而说出可以叫他「爷爷」的这种话。就在此时,莱利娜配戴的珠宝发饰发出了诡异的光芒。

programme.desc: 努尔拜访了现今国王,也是他的异母哥哥希亚托里希。当他终于开口提到自己与莱利娜所缔结之契约,希亚托里希当面指出,现在议会会期即将结束,应该已不再需要这个婚约的事实。与此同时,莱利娜前往温奈特家墓地,贝儿托利丝是否会如同小说所描写的一样出现呢?

programme.desc: 茜参加了在FOS联名咖啡厅举办的公会线下聚会。虽然她认出山田与疑似是琉璃姬的两人,但对于现场出现的两位男性──瑛太与鸭田却完全没印象。在自我介绍时,鸭田自称是在FOS中名叫takezo的草莓农夫。而另一位瑛太则是茜万万没想到的某位玩家。

programme.title: 和山田谈场LV999的恋爱 #5
programme.desc: 茜虽然想和公会成员们打好关系,但她隐约察觉到瑛太的妹妹琉奈有所保留的态度。琉奈主动邀她去咖啡厅,让茜一度心情大好。但这其实是琉奈的恶作剧,在现场等著的是自称琉璃姬狂热粉丝的陌生男子。而到佐佐木家担任家教的山田察觉到琉奈的神情异常。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #11
programme.desc: 女仆告诫莱利娜千万不能去看位于西馆深处的镜子。因为有传闻说若和镜中魂四目交接,它就会告诉来者任何事情。但莱利娜想知道小说女主角贝儿托利丝的所在,仍在夜晚拿起了镜子。当奇怪的声音吓得莱利娜缩起身体时,出现在她面前的竟不是镜中魂,而是努尔。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #12
programme.desc: 努尔拜访了现今国王,也是他的异母哥哥希亚托里希。当他终于开口提到自己与莱利娜所缔结之契约,希亚托里希当面指出,现在议会会期即将结束,应该已不再需要这个婚约的事实。与此同时,莱利娜前往温奈特家墓地,贝儿托利丝是否会如同小说所描写的一样出现呢?

programme.desc: 每天早晨透过诗歌安静心灵,从牧者及嘉宾的分享学习圣经中的真理,让观众由浅入深认识信仰,默想圣经教导

programme.title: 来!为这城祷告
programme.desc: 你们要为那城求平安,为那城祷告耶和华;因为那城得平安,你们也随著得平安(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球大神秘
programme.desc: 从世界各地搜集到数以百计奇异事物内容,都是无法以一般人接受的观点加以解释,除非这个世界在科学理论上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人说,人生是一场戏,在人生的过程中,寻找有时,碰壁有时,迷失有时,觉醒有时,说真的,这些起承转合比真正的电影情节更精彩,每一个「你」,都是天父特别设计的人生剧本主角 今天,我们的世界充满了末世风情,醉生梦死,迷失自我了结生命的悲剧每天上演,创世电视藉100个见证故事挽救生命,100位来自世界各地

programme.title: 如果还有明天2 艺人﹐警察﹐过来人
programme.desc: 在社会上有三类人,他们的故事往往起伏跌宕,引人注目n艺人─身处五光十色的娱乐圈,昨日一炮而红,今天却随时一沉百踩,明天,是黯淡无光抑或光辉璀璨?n员警─冲锋陷阵,与死亡正面交锋的职业,在捍卫他人生命和财产,让市民有美好明天时,自己的明天又能否好好捍卫?n过来人─昔日在黑道中打混,见尽各种腥风血雨的

programme.title: 主日讲坛-基督之家第五家
programme.desc: 基督之家第五家 讲题:您不可不知 人每一天都要面对很多抉择,要将上帝的智慧应用在生活不同层面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧师和传道人的讲道中,往往都能够得到启迪透过主日讲坛,更明白神的道并在生活中寻求到神喜悦的心意

programme.title: 粤讲粤㜺鬼粤
programme.desc: 压轴一集，大妈们在社区会堂跳着熟练舞步，对宠物、表演、食物相关歇后语又有多少认识？俗语「豆泥」源自糕点馅料；「苏虾仔」正写是「苏孲崽」，大学讲师廖舜禧逐一解构。三位主持和黄建东在怀旧士多「寻宝」，竟分别互称表兄妹，究竟搞边科？「摩罗街雨褛－ 过底」有何喻意？掌故专家郑宝鸿并讲解摩罗街叫摩罗街的原因。主持们走进果栏了解「发财丁」、「坐车」等行内术语；还向毛冷舖店主请教不同毛冷的质地及保存毛衣方法。

programme.title: 粤讲粤㜺鬼粤
programme.desc: 传统金器手工精巧，现代机器难以取代。主持人来到金舖欣赏各款名贵首饰，期间竟有人被称呼为「石狗公」，有何所指？花生糖保持古法人手炮制，昔日风味得以保存。麦美恩亲自拜师学习做糖，顺道细谈「石地板种花生」、「发霉花生」等歇后语。「老细」、「事头」何以成为上司代名词？且听中文讲师廖舜禧拆解。粤语逾二千年来原来甚少演变，故被视为古汉语「活化石」。廖舜禧追溯广府话历史，还从「锡」「勼」「冧」三字解构爱情真义！

programme.title: 大玩特玩粤
programme.desc: 主持与十位艺员在购物城内疯狂玩乐！「吹杯过杯」只有连诗雅「食白果」，她在问答环节还要玩了半小时才知道「答问题要先举手」；相反，何君诚的表现令人喜出望外。众人斗快「不用手穿裤子」，黄美棋使出瑜伽动作、周志康化身人肉四驱车，怪招尽出。出线比赛坐飞毡赛跑，何雁诗被对手大幅抛离，幸好最后一棒是美棋对连诗雅，赛果可想而知！

programme.title: 熊猫一家人粤普
programme.desc: 各实习饲养员结束了康养区和繁育园的学习和工作，回到神树坪基地。这段时间，导师们见证了各实习生的成长过程，对他们的进步都感到满意。另一方面，为了教育园区游客关于熊猫的基础知识，实习生们举办了教育课堂。

programme.title: 星梦频道粤日
programme.desc: 绘萌、安娜、凛花的演唱会顺利结束了，宝石偶像等待著四眼姐姐公布接下来的顺序。但是，表演顺序还没出炉，玫儿就已经站上舞台，还开始进行演唱会。在玫儿促使下，其他宝石偶像也相继登上舞台。

programme.title: 星梦频道粤日
programme.desc: 钻石时装大赛进入最高潮，尚未登台的宝石偶像只剩虹之咲、未来、杏树三人。宝石时装大赛开办者虹之咲，奇迹闪耀组的中心人物未来，还有星梦频道偶像顶点的杏树，钻石偶像的宝座到底花落谁家!?

programme.title: 多啦A梦粤
programme.desc: 大雄见家里经济财政紧绌，于是走去寻宝，多啦A梦知道后借他「寻宝机」和「飘浮喷雾」。大雄不小心害静香的胸针掉进水塘，用过法宝「加醋减醋」后心生一计，但在前往水塘的路上遭遇诸多阻挠。

programme.title: B-PROJECT超星团粤日
programme.desc: 在翼的努力之下，Ultras的工作渐上轨道，但A太却因为一次误会而抱怨翼把B-PROJECT放在优先，本身对Ultras颇有微词的刚士因而与A太发生冲突，讵料此时公司却下令要B-PROJECT发展YourTube，理想做法自然是请教精于此道的Ultras。

programme.title: 魔都女行粤
programme.desc: 发掘「魔都」隐世美食，来到地道面馆，娅溦、糖妹按照网上排名点菜，蛤蜊猪肝拌面、茄盒、腰花辣肉汤面，果真名不虚传。光顾传闻「怪脾气」师傅蛋糕店、古早味冰糕与人气脆香鲜肉月饼，风味小吃滋味连连。主持们被「古董花园」复古氛围吸引，优雅地浅尝美式松饼与造型蛋糕。接着游逛老上海欧式风格小区，先打卡再觅食。入黑，味蕾试试新口味，主打越南粉的东南亚餐厅，可会是两位主持杯茶？酒吧内的鸡尾酒名字趣怪，越夜越精彩！

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粤
programme.desc: 肥妈提到羊肉有滋阴、补肾的功效，是进补的上佳食材。「印度羊肉饭」用上的印度米淀粉含量较低，而且纤维丰富，适合减肥人士。阿妈另将芫荽头、黑胡椒、鱼露等，加入免治羊肉中拌匀，再做成串烧，菜式同样充满异国风味。「孜然羊架」需要先煎后焗，但腌制步骤才是重点，有何独门秘方？三道羊菜式均香浓惹味，肥妈特意准备清甜解腻的「菠萝椰花糖雪花冰」作甜品。她带6号到果栏选购菠萝，泰国、台湾与菲律宾的品种究竟有甚么分别？

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粤
programme.desc: 6号「单拖」到街市买海鲜，并发挥节目宗旨落力讲价！他买来蛋白质丰富的鲍鱼，让肥妈炮制「姜葱蚝油鲜鲍鱼」。鲍鱼裙边呈现黑色，怎样清洁？「酸菜鱼」用上以鱼头与鱼骨煮成的鱼汤，鲜上加鲜；阿妈还提醒泡椒才是辣味来源，要小心用量。蒸虾菜式以粉丝和胜瓜置底，能够吸收虾的鲜味。制作「凉拌小鲜鱿」时，阿6竟拿自己与肥妈的身形教大家分辨鱿鱼和墨鱼，当然惹得阿妈发火！另外，6号又会示范时下火热饮品奶盖茶的DIY做法。

programme.title: 少年中医说粤普
programme.desc: 节目聚焦于青年族群体验中医药文化，集结中国七所中医药的7名高校学子，在主持人和中医药名家的带领下，探寻中华医圣故里，以「盲盒路线分组体验」医圣故里的形式，了解医圣对当代中医药发展的启示。

programme.title: 约埋班Friend去旅行粤PG
programme.desc: 振朗三人跟澳洲名胜三姐妹峰打卡，某人合照时笑言其美貌无死角！路旁驶来红色跑车，只有两名幸运儿可自驾游车河，对讲机的另一端则不断传来被抛下那一位的「葡萄」话语。众主持于下午茶时间聊天，话题竟是围绕内裤「乱噏」！到达豪华住宿地，朱仔躺进浴缸中不愿起来。振朗随后躺在其身上，还哼起歌来，果真有福同享？入夜，大家把酒谈心。三人于剧集《反黑路人甲》建立友谊，谈及这剧的拍摄点滴，振朗有一幕忍笑失败仍被播出？

programme.title: 约埋班Friend去旅行粤PG
programme.desc: 众主持搭乘空中缆车睇靓景，期间更可登上车顶。振朗出发前曾许愿要和慰玲拍MV，来到大型花园，节目组让他化身「张导」，并争分夺秒完成拍摄。MV用上「反黑」剧歌<对手戏，请细心观赏个中的「三角恋」演出。走进豪华游艇来趟船屋体验，主持们边用餐边诉说家人对各自演艺路的支持。三好友盛装到海边，原来是乘坐水上飞机，振朗更于空中与悉尼歌剧院打卡。在可欣赏海滩胜景的餐厅用膳，大家倾谈结婚话题外，朱仔还会「剧透」！

programme.title: 甜心先生粤
programme.desc: 吃甜品的口味，与个人形象、性格并无直接关系，甜品达人阿古(古嘉俊) 与嘉宾温家伟(大只仔)，虽然外形特质大不相同，却原来大家同是英式下午茶的「拥趸」。有见及此，阿古特意准备了一款下午茶常见的松饼，并以新鲜水果制成大只仔最爱的蓝莓果酱，让他安坐家中也能享用精美茶点。大只仔就在制作甜品过程中发掘了不少窍门，足见他的细密心思。完成作品后，大只仔亦会分享制作心得，以及透露心目中一种与下午茶最匹配的美食。

programme.title: 新干线战士 改变世界粤日
programme.desc: 天惊讶于太晴三人相识只有两个月便能百无禁忌，太晴告诉他重点在于互相尊重的心。UNKNOWN出现，太晴三人陷入苦战，天想通后重新坐上新干线战士，更凭著准确的观察和指示，成功以战术击败敌人。

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 「My Little Show」的才艺表演舞台再次展开，三位女孩伴随节拍翩翩起舞，带来可爱的芭蕾表演，洋溢童真魅力。另一位女生则以古筝弹奏桂林少数民族的舞曲，优雅琴音为现场增添古典气息。随着女结他导师弹奏<幼稚园、<告别校园时，她与主持姐姐放声合唱，勾起许多美好的校园回忆，滢仴姐姐尤其难忘有同学仔不小心在课堂上放屁的趣事。

programme.title: 屁屁侦探粤日
programme.desc: 箭猪荒山在山上挖掘寻宝但一无所获，后来遇到摊档的蚯蚓妈妈，听信其占卜并带她上山。汪汪警察局接报蚯蚓妈妈被绑架，屁屁侦探亦获邀加入调查，一行人根据种种线索，上山追查蚯蚓妈妈下落。

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子粤日
programme.desc: 小丸子家里电视机故障，需要三天时间才能修好，小丸子自不用说，连姐姐也罕有地表示不满。小玉正在看一本小说，并和冬田约好看完后互相分享感想，但过程中一直有事令她分心，导致阅读进度缓慢。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粤
programme.desc: 香港特区政府带领各个部门及单位，适时推出不同的政策措施，为本港市民、到访旅客、来自外地的投资者提供便捷服务。香港这么好，当然要多说一些让大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以轻松有趣的拍摄手法，配合陈豪、高海宁、张振朗、刘佩玥、周嘉洛、罗子溢、马国明、陈懿德、陈展鹏、刘颖旋等一众星级艺员，透过不同角色、形象，生动地表达香港的各样美好和优势。

programme.title: 潜行天下粤
programme.desc: 《潜行天下》以全球海洋为主题，采用8K超高清摄影机和水下无人机等技术建构沉浸式观影体验，跨越四大洋14国水域拍摄，记录双髻鲨、鲸鲨等海洋生物活动，探密三沙永乐龙洞等特殊地形。

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报道本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 星期日档案粤
programme.desc: 戏棚在香港已有大约150年历史，过往每逢神诞、太平清醮、盂兰胜会，一座座临时戏棚便会以竹、木搭建而成，棚内或做拜神仪式，或做「神功戏」表演。不过随著城市发展及经济转型，不少拜神仪式已经简化，部分社区在盂兰胜会期间，更会转用金属取缔竹木搭建的戏棚。面对行业式微，一群戏棚师傅如何延续传统的竹棚技艺？

programme.title: 警声百二秒 III粤
programme.desc: 「警声百二秒」系列再次归来，《警声百二秒 III》由警方代表联同众多艺员参与演出，会继续透过有趣的故事情节，介绍香港警务处更多部门的工作、更多防罪讯息，让广大市民可轻松「全方位」了解警队更多资讯。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 旺角道行人天桥何故火光闪闪？原来这个外佣假日聚脚点仿如美食广场，一个个纸皮箱之下隐约可见明火炉具，街坊担心成安全隐患。节目抢先介绍四届视后佘诗曼主演新剧《正义女神》；TVB全新营销团队才骏轩，为客户提供度身订造媒体服务，视帝陈豪、谭俊彦连同陈贝儿等星级代言人，推介服务详情。运输署「免试签发」驾驶执照采用电子即日筹申领之后，依然一筹难求！记者与报料观众清晨上网，实测轮筹难度；非即日的预约情况又如何？

programme.title: 香港欧化飞鹰活络油呈献:中年好声音4粤
programme.desc: 导师分组赛迎来最终回，台上再次举行独唱较量，三队代表分别演绎那英、张学友、张惠妹的作品。这集最低分队伍要淘汰一人之外，本轮三集累积总分最低队伍亦会有两人被淘汰，竞争越趋白热化！红队布志纶、紫队高少华、绿队张嘉铭，三位导师各自带领的学员当中，谁人即将离开《中4》舞台？此外，这集亦会诞生本辑节目的首位MVP。

programme.title: 一周星星粤
programme.desc: 黎耀祥、萧正楠、曹永廉因参演《大太监》而熟络，早前拍综艺自驾游澳洲，有何深刻点滴？除了啜核挖苦的日常外，他们亦会有浪漫一面！「你问我答」，黎诺懿向祥哥索「拎视帝」秘诀，祥哥亦妙趣示范相同对白的三种演绎。阿萧又可「恨得奖」？阿廉的腰围受黄智贤关注，主持潘盈慧拿出量尺……某人录音控诉阿萧常与阿廉通电话，又不时穿著对方衣服，莫非有不可告人之事？三位好丈夫又会如何回答「我今日有何不同」这条经典的女伴提问？

programme.title: 美食新闻周报粤
programme.desc: 星厨莫灿霖推介居酒屋，与波波享用炒墨鱼配木鱼酱油汁、高森和牛三文治配牛骨汤，令人回味无穷。北角地胆施焯日走访该区的食街，试吃吞拿鱼苹果碎蛋比高包、不同馅料的煎饺，以及台式麻酱凉面配卤水百页豆腐。Agnes再带焯日品尝新派韩式风味亚洲料理，包括配上水果特制酱汁的鱿鱼刺身、咖喱韩式炸鸡，以及绍酒醉酱油蟹，尽是不一样的味道。九龙城开业逾七十年的清真菜馆，其爆汁牛肉饼、羊肉小笼包与咖喱羊腩，皆为必试名物。

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤
programme.desc: 报道本地、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向。

programme.title: 叠影狙击#8粤PG
programme.desc: 晓晨潜入文诺的办公室放下窃听器，怎料被监控镜头拍下来了，于是将错就错，假装投靠文诺，并藉著人工岛的计划书，取得俊雄的信任。恒辉无故失踪，天齐怀疑院长谋财害命，于是潜入院长室，竟然发现大量老人的身份证…

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 旺角道行人天桥何故火光闪闪？原来这个外佣假日聚脚点仿如美食广场，一个个纸皮箱之下隐约可见明火炉具，街坊担心成安全隐患。节目抢先介绍四届视后佘诗曼主演新剧《正义女神》；TVB全新营销团队才骏轩，为客户提供度身订造媒体服务，视帝陈豪、谭俊彦连同陈贝儿等星级代言人，推介服务详情。运输署「免试签发」驾驶执照采用电子即日筹申领之后，依然一筹难求！记者与报料观众清晨上网，实测轮筹难度；非即日的预约情况又如何？

programme.title: 少年中医说粤普
programme.desc: 节目聚焦于青年族群体验中医药文化，集结中国七所中医药的7名高校学子，在主持人和中医药名家的带领下，探寻中华医圣故里，以「盲盒路线分组体验」医圣故里的形式，了解医圣对当代中医药发展的启示。

programme.title: 约埋班Friend去旅行粤PG
programme.desc: 四人到清迈郊外等待看日出，并诉说相关经历。和嘉洛同往看日出许愿竟是两男？JW最有记忆的日出，是与吴业坤一起拍剧。畏高的JW鼓起勇气试玩动力滑翔伞，降落即要求拥抱互勉。登艇游河兼食船面，甚么令陈滢眼湿湿？走进市场，大家开始试吃之行，JW献出食榴梿第一次。主持们换上民族服，边品尝地道美食边欣赏民族表演。四人分组在周末市集买食物开餐，同时考验另类默契。挑战丛林间的过山车与飞索，JW能否再次战胜恐惧？

programme.title: 约埋班Friend去旅行粤PG
programme.desc: 深入清迈乡村逛小店，朱仔竟踊跃发言，拍档都配合地转为「静音模式」。朱仔更挑战JW底线要其吃蜜蜂蛋，吓得她落荒而逃！四人分享清迈之旅难忘点滴，有人讲到喊，更发觉此行绝对不容嘉洛缺席！大家还透过收到的礼物，竞猜自己的「秘密天使」……张振朗、赖慰玲接力出发，办理飞澳洲的登机手续之际，朱仔惊喜送机，却是「计中计」，他会乘坐航班的商务位同行。站在海水中央食蚝，可有特别感受？不过，振朗的熟练开蚝技术才是焦点！

programme.title: 甜心先生粤
programme.desc: 吃甜品的口味，与个人形象、性格并无直接关系，甜品达人阿古(古嘉俊) 与嘉宾温家伟(大只仔)，虽然外形特质大不相同，却原来大家同是英式下午茶的「拥趸」。有见及此，阿古特意准备了一款下午茶常见的松饼，并以新鲜水果制成大只仔最爱的蓝莓果酱，让他安坐家中也能享用精美茶点。大只仔就在制作甜品过程中发掘了不少窍门，足见他的细密心思。完成作品后，大只仔亦会分享制作心得，以及透露心目中一种与下午茶最匹配的美食。

programme.title: 魔都女行粤
programme.desc: 糖妹、娅溦变身优雅吃货，置身以老香港美学打造的点心餐厅，品尝炖老鸽汤、波龙芦笋饺、Q弹太雕蛋蒸黄鱼，黑米咸水角又有甚么惊喜滋味？两位可人儿转往别致Cafe，一件拿破仑草莓蛋糕，她们竟掀起吉士酱与奶油之争！分途发掘魔都小店，糖妹踏足潮人必到的中古风生活杂货，搜罗各式可爱造型的创意家品。另一边厢，娅溦在澳洲网红旗舰店朝圣，「悉瓜」蛋糕一试难忘。放慢脚步，二人偷得浮生光顾酒馆，糖妹还会挑战辣辣上海川菜！

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粤
programme.desc: 肥妈提到羊肉有滋阴、补肾的功效，是进补的上佳食材。「印度羊肉饭」用上的印度米淀粉含量较低，而且纤维丰富，适合减肥人士。阿妈另将芫荽头、黑胡椒、鱼露等，加入免治羊肉中拌匀，再做成串烧，菜式同样充满异国风味。「孜然羊架」需要先煎后焗，但腌制步骤才是重点，有何独门秘方？三道羊菜式均香浓惹味，肥妈特意准备清甜解腻的「菠萝椰花糖雪花冰」作甜品。她带6号到果栏选购菠萝，泰国、台湾与菲律宾的品种究竟有甚么分别？

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粤
programme.desc: 6号「单拖」到街市买海鲜，并发挥节目宗旨落力讲价！他买来蛋白质丰富的鲍鱼，让肥妈炮制「姜葱蚝油鲜鲍鱼」。鲍鱼裙边呈现黑色，怎样清洁？「酸菜鱼」用上以鱼头与鱼骨煮成的鱼汤，鲜上加鲜；阿妈还提醒泡椒才是辣味来源，要小心用量。蒸虾菜式以粉丝和胜瓜置底，能够吸收虾的鲜味。制作「凉拌小鲜鱿」时，阿6竟拿自己与肥妈的身形教大家分辨鱿鱼和墨鱼，当然惹得阿妈发火！另外，6号又会示范时下火热饮品奶盖茶的DIY做法。

programme.title: 熊猫一家人粤普
programme.desc: 各实习饲养员结束了康养区和繁育园的学习和工作，回到神树坪基地。这段时间，导师们见证了各实习生的成长过程，对他们的进步都感到满意。另一方面，为了教育园区游客关于熊猫的基础知识，实习生们举办了教育课堂。

programme.title: 香港早晨粤 及 交通消息粤
香港早晨粤 及 交通消息粤
香港早晨粤 及 交通消息粤
高朋满座#54粤
programme.desc: 庆智擒小偷，被颁良好市民奖外，就连电视台也来采访。喜发现药房近日常无故失窃，就连义的名牌衫裤也忽然被偷，最终揭发犯人竟是「捉贼英雄」庆。原来高庆是因为要替社区中心筹款购买乒乓桌，才甘愿作贼。

programme.title: 天龙八部#27粤普PG
programme.desc: 虚竹因破了四戒，少林高僧决定将他逐出师门，并处以杖刑，此时传来各大武林人士前来拜访的消息，段誉、丁春秋、阿紫、慕容复同时在场。丁春秋以阿紫要胁庄聚贤，萧峰突然现身，段誉、虚竹与萧峰兄弟聚头，惺惺相惜。

programme.title: 交易现场粤 及 潮流生活志粤
阿爷厨房粤
programme.desc: 贝壳类海鲜五花八门，跟鼎爷到街市长知识。鼎爷先制作「元贝蒸豆腐」，在元贝上?十字花有何作用？鼎爷再以鲜炸猪油爆香料头、酒酿、鸡件，加上生抽、红枣等兜炒成惹味「三杯鸡」，还道出菜式的故事。鼎爷与阿谭到南海，品尝新鲜霸王花、霸王花干菜式。为何霸王花干要先蒸后晒？鼎爷再送上时令补身佳肴，以鹿茸大补酒、陈皮、玉竹等制作「酒炖排骨」。鼎爷再以樱花虾，加上鲜虾薄片、大豆芽炮制炒饭，香脆口感从哪里来？

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 口腔卫生差是舌癌成因之一，如口腔溃疡逾两周仍未愈合就要提高警觉。临床肿瘤科医生指出，蛀牙也会增加患舌癌风险，还有甚么口腔问题要留意？此外，医生亦细说舌癌的防治资讯。资深歌手张德兰即将开骚，她曾多次踏上红馆舞台，却是首次在那里举行个唱？她透露可圆梦除了有赖好友叶振棠牵线，也因制作人的盛情难却。德兰姐姐更紧贴时代开设社交帐号，对能跟各地歌迷拉近距离感开心。「睇𩠌食饭」，陈国宾示范「南瓜汁椰菜花虾球」。

programme.title: 一条麻甩在东莞粤
programme.desc: 东莞方言「去归」，就是回家的意思。主持王祖蓝这集就带观众「去归」，来到他的老家厚街，先品尝一顿菜肴丰富的「自给自足」东莞家宴。在厚街一定要享用的，还有驰名的腊味和烧味美食，一间廿四小时营业的烧味店，出品到底有多好吃？及至晚上，祖蓝于「黄金小镇」游逛、「扫街」，这个夜市究竟有些甚么吸引着厚街的打工人？

programme.title: 灿烂的外母#6粤
programme.desc: 德正偷偷带美娜参观豆品厂却被秀琼发现，众人到厂房开战……秀琼得知司徒岚是兆明女友，反对二人交往。兆明向窦彰说出他和司徒岚相识经过；司徒岚带兆明见秀琼，秀琼称他没法给司徒岚幸福。兆明进行第二阶段计划，有意与超市合作，但窦彰反对；窦彰说出心中怨气，更将计划书撕毁。秀琼设计由文员萧文芳向兆明挑逗，但美人计失败；秀琼拿出支票任他填写，条件是要他离开司徒岚……兆明奇怪兆贤何以在鼎福和出现，兆贤坦言已退学……

programme.title: 偶像星愿7 Third BEAT!粤日
programme.desc: 万在演唱会上为救千，被照明击中受伤。消息指万因脸部受伤而失踪，百上门力劝千勿放弃唱歌，并提出以五年为期，与他拍档去闯出名堂。了听百说完后依然不为所动，百无奈离开，并在楼下遇到千。

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 早于十九至二十世纪，香港的矿业十分兴盛，而位于北区近沙头角的莲麻坑矿洞，近期更重新开放让市民参观。这集「Kids’ Notes」，两位嘉宾带同几款矿石，推介矿洞必到「打卡位」，并提醒参观时的注意事项。香港曾经有近百个大大小小的石矿场，大致上都以花岗岩为主，原来美利楼、终审法院大楼都是用上本地石矿场出产的花岗岩建成！鲤鱼门以海鲜闻名，原来之前也是一个大型石矿场？且听嘉宾细说更多相关历史资讯。

programme.title: 多啦A梦粤
programme.desc: 妈妈要求大雄整理房间，多啦A梦借他「整理陈列室」，助他筛选出没用杂物，好丢掉腾出空间。大雄嫌上学路沉闷，多啦A梦用「交换地图」为他制造新奇路线，其后更以此设计赛道，举行一场大赛车。

programme.title: 财经新闻粤
programme.desc: 紧贴市况，逢交易日下午5时50分报道当日本港和外围股市行情，以及重点财经新闻。

programme.title: 利嘉阁地产45 周年真盘源特约：今日有楼睇粤 及 潮流生活志粤
programme.desc: 楼市升势持续，鲗鱼涌一个大型屋苑，成交也有所加快，楼价有否跟随向上？

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报道本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 世界观粤 及 天气报告粤
东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 黄道益活络油呈献：爱． 回家之开心速递#2764粤
programme.desc: Ceci与敢威合作发展某项工程，到期需缴付工程费，却以卜卜脆病倒入院为由，拒绝商谈此事。眼看Ceci极看重卜卜脆，视她如同姊妹，力莲有意取代她，并设法与Ceci结义金兰，阴差阳错下却令Ceci决意顺应「天机」，认定瑞素为义妹。出于某些原因，瑞素暂住Ceci的别墅，意外发现其秘密。另一方面，瑞素欲讨好敢威，敢威却不屑一顾，毫不领情。Ceci相约敢威、雷公等人会面，宣布与瑞素有关之事，众人震惊不已……

programme.title: X Wallet呈献:卧底娇娃#16粤PG
programme.desc: 两年前，刚潜入二世的奕风压力巨大。洗衣店的一次机器故障，奕风情绪爆发，却因电话投诉认识一位女客服。对方甜美的声音，循循善诱的态度，温柔体贴的举动，让奕风得到治愈。奕风屡次借口致电对方寻求慰藉，某天客服竟换了人！奕风替世豪收数，对象恰巧是这客服的邻居。二人终相认，但奕风同时让对方目睹其暴力扭曲的一面；幸好于奕风的嫲嫲加持下，两人关系亲近不少。一切似是向好发展之际，嫲嫲的去世却为奕风带来沉重打击……

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈献：机智女法医2#8粤普PG
programme.desc: 皇帝下令严惩赵森垚，南赵王承认推动法师之死。楚楚与冷月访慈光寺，得知法师曾收养一子净缘，生母沁香坦承曾谎称净缘为法师之子，另揭露有人以香粉操控教坊司女子勾引客人。瑾瑜忧心南赵幕后主使，皇帝命其暗查。

programme.title: 宏利保险呈献：他们的澳洲驾期粤
programme.desc: 登机准备向墨尔本出发，黎耀祥、萧正楠举杯祝愿旅途顺利，曹永廉却不获「欢迎」？自驾游第一站行逛市集与购物拱廊，品尝地道美食，诉说「兄弟情」。置身历史悠久的美术馆，三子藉参观展览、绘画体验，滋养艺术气息。往布勒山路途遥远，「司机」阿廉却连启动汽车都出事，老友们如何安心充电？坐吊车登雪山，三位大细路心急互掷雪球，快问快答游戏更变集火爆料时间！三人随训练员同乘一车，享受雪橇犬拉车的爽快感，却差点冲出悬崖？

programme.title: 娱乐头条粤 及 环球新闻档案粤
programme.desc: 节目主要以当日的娱乐新闻作重点，让你瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈动态和最新消息，并以「娱乐大事件」、「抢闸头条」、「出炉猛料」等为主题作头条新闻式报道。

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤
programme.desc: 报道本地、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向。

programme.title: 天气报告粤 及 潮流生活志粤
康业信贷快递呈献：寻秦记#24粤
programme.desc: 赵倩与娘蓉不约而同看中一幅红衣料，娘蓉气荆俊口不择言，将所有红衣料买光。娘蓉向不韦打听少龙是何人后，带著红衣料访赵倩，说要替她设计嫁衣，更羡慕赵倩为追求所爱抛开一切。朱姬遂举荐嫪毐出任廷尉，嬴政即推荐少龙，不韦附和。不韦看出嫪毐野心，提醒他安分。赵倩发现杀少龙密令，嫪毐面露杀机。少龙等押赵穆入咸阳，嬴政想起雅遭赵穆蹂躏致死，将匕首直刺赵穆心脏。少龙看见赵倩死不瞑目躺在江边，悲痛欲绝，持剑直闯吕府。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 阿爷厨房粤
programme.desc: 阿谭引领鼎爷前往搜罗上海菜食材，烤麸正是其中所爱。烹调「上海烤麸」，还会用上金针，鼎爷期间向阿谭讲述二者的起源故事。鼎爷竟不施展刀功，反而用手将烤麸撕碎？烤麸要待凉才可享用，鼎爷把握时间带来非一般的「家常菜饭」，还出动猪油为菜饭的味道升华。二人再到老字号面厂，参观云吞皮的制作过程。只包上海云吞，岂能满足阿谭的口胃，鼎爷加码炮制「砂锅云吞鸡」。主持们提醒用白菜做馅料要先焯煮榨干，否则云吞皮容易弄穿！

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 转季期间特别多花粉散播，容易诱发敏感性哮喘，要诊断出可有患上哮喘，呼吸系统科医生提到需完成几项检查。哮喘当前的一线治疗是甚么？又是如何判别病人是否适合采用生物制剂？吴文忻分享过抗癌路之后，这集豁然畅谈好友为她而办的「在世追思会」，她现时还希望实现哪些梦想？患病经历让文忻感受到不同的爱，她会诉说个中的感动事，为同路人注入正能量。「睇𩠌食饭」，三姐将过年吃剩的年糕配搭韩国白年糕，炮制「脆皮鸳鸯年糕」。

programme.title: 一条麻甩在东莞粤
programme.desc: 本集开启寻找东莞高埗镇特色美食之旅，祖蓝引领大家于一天内品尝两道「非遗」食品。第一道当然是高埗最出名的水乡菜系美食— 冼沙鱼丸，另一道则是保安围扣肉，看似普通的鱼丸与扣肉，制作起来一点都不简单，祖蓝还会亲自落场试做一番。此外，高埗镇内还藏着一家不起眼的糖水舖，食品于开业廿多年来近乎没有加价，就是其招牌……

programme.title: 灿烂的外母#7粤PG

programme.title: 偶像星愿7 Third BEAT!粤日
programme.desc: IDOLiSH7、TRIGGER和Re:vale获邀成为重头慈善节目「Friends Day」的主持，而先导环节系三个团体突然被安排前往热海集训，并需要在24小时内为节目创作主题曲，但这群我行我素的偶像让各自的经纪人提心吊胆。

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 「厂长话」游戏，两队各有一人率先出局，剩下的队友为获得零食秘笈奖励奋战。然而「厂长话」跳两下时，有人竟没反应……稍后执行神奇地壶任务，双方表现各异。某队经过五次尝试才「拿下」首个奇幻食材，另一队则有成员连番一击即中。踏入看图砌汉堡关卡，首回合中，两队均曾放错食材顺序，需要花时间调整。在接下来的两回合比拼，小兵们要更加专注，避免再次拿错而延误完成时间。「AI小学堂」，嘉宾分享可怎样在学习上善用AI。

programme.title: 忍者乱太郎粤日
programme.desc: 小丸原本想应征的兼职，被二年级前辈抢先受聘了。斜堂老师被校医劝说，为了健康，必须多些在阳光下做运动。乱太郎连续两晚的梦都应验了。第三晚，乱太郎梦到测验取得100分。乱太郎对此充满期待。

programme.title: 财经新闻粤
programme.desc: 紧贴市况，逢交易日下午5时50分报道当日本港和外围股市行情，以及重点财经新闻。

programme.title: 马百良六宝灵芝呈献:最强生命线粤
programme.desc: 多发性骨髓瘤是体内浆细胞癌变的血液恶性肿瘤，一般好发于60至70岁以上的年长者。主要症状包括高血钙、肾功能不全、贫血、骨头病变（骨痛或骨折）。由于该病容易复发，目前仍然是难以完全治愈的慢性病，但有包括标靶、免疫调节剂，以及干细胞移植治疗，可大幅延长存活期。

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报道本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 黄道益活络油呈献：爱． 回家之开心速递#2765粤
programme.desc: 尚善通宵赶工撰写计划书，抢先于力莲呈交，也获敢威通过。力莲不忿之余，更得知敢威似对她心存不满，还有意「传位」予尚善。为求争取更佳表现，力莲遂通宵撰写另一项目的计划书，成功与合作方签约后，又继续马不停蹄地处理其他事务。其后，力莲获俊华告知由他自创的特别休息方法，只需利用极短时间，便能「叉电」回复精神。力莲照办，初时成效显著，但渐渐却出现问题，甚至难以入眠。为求成功入睡，她作出了不少尝试……

programme.title: X Wallet呈献:卧底娇娃#17粤
programme.desc: 小茹成功登入嘉盈的电脑，发现电脑疑被掉包，佳琪怀疑是奕风所为。另边厢，妙姿发现刘彪的秘密。佳琪发现邦妮似乎早已知悉刘彪出轨。佳琪偷偷在奕风的嫲嫲家中安装监视装置，果然发现是奕风偷走嘉盈的电脑，却于监控内见到奕风情绪有异。小茹一直在撮合欧凯和宝仪，欧凯终忍不住向小茹说出他有喜欢的人。佳琪的父亲沈逸良心脏病发，她及后还得知自己遗忘了的一段记忆。小茹探望索帕，惊悉对方原来就是卧底小组一直调查的目标人物。

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈献：机智女法医2#9粤普PG
programme.desc: 瑾瑜请画眉赐教之际传来惊呼声，竟是沁香落水身亡。楚楚发现沁香身上有可疑痕迹，想解剖尸体，瑾瑜虽担心她会染上疳霉疮，但仍批准并叮嘱她小心。沁香兄嫂到教坊闹事，瑾瑜向画眉询问情况，再与楚楚去沁香房间查看。

programme.title: 宏利保险呈献：他们的澳洲驾期粤
programme.desc: 继续雪山玩乐之行，三兄弟体验滑雪，单是学习单脚滑行已甚疲累？祥哥、阿萧升呢挑战初阶雪道，阿廉却耍手拧头……转玩老少咸宜的雪兜，阿廉又被作弄，「炒车」收场！速度大激斗，输家要替老友「揸兜」？谈到自驾游经验，阿萧难忘与太太黄翠如往海外注册的趣事。漫步吉朗的海滨步道，触发「寻找指定彩绘木偶」任务，阿萧还将木偶当成爱妻？沿大洋路海岸线行驶，三人买朱古力手信、在纪念拱门打卡，再登高细诉事业与家庭的高光时刻。

programme.title: 康业信贷快递呈献：寻秦记#25粤
programme.desc: 少龙求秦王下旨搜查吕府。少龙在花园发现赵倩的衣服破布及娘蓉送给她的小兔，又找出八人在案发时没有不在场证据，包括嫪毐及娘蓉。少龙在马车上发现赵倩的珠钗，激动地欲杀车伕。少龙推辞出任廷尉，朱姬乘机再推荐嫪毐。朱姬要秦王陪她到骊山浸温泉，秦王建议由嬴政陪她。嫪毐与朱姬牵手往浸温泉，成𫊸母秀丽夫人向秦王告密，秦王去捉奸却见池中只有朱姬一人，将秀丽打入冷宫，朱姬暗喜。少龙在赵倩墓前拜祭，离开时赫见琴清出现。

programme.title: 猪猪侠之超星五灵侠S3
programme.desc: 猪猪侠与同伴接收到来自九霄星的求救信号，尽管他们已经失去了强大的超能力，但热心肠的猪猪们仍然义无反顾地再次启航，前往那个充满未知数的陌生星球。来到九霄星后，猪猪们看到了整个星球的地表都被灼热的岩浆覆盖，而空中竟然悬浮着许多壮观宏大、各具特色的天空之城。但是，这些天空之城正在陆续失去能让它们悬浮的五灵元素，面临坠毁的威胁。猪猪侠等人寻找背后的原因，并耍起功夫，抵抗反派邪恶力量，使出浑身解数拯救天空之城。一场守护正义、保护天空之城的全新冒险之旅开始啦。

programme.title: 检索爱情
programme.desc: 【林秀晶X张基龙大谈姐弟恋年下男狂撩职场女强人】聚焦于三位35岁女性——裴朵美、车贤和宋佳景，她们在职场和感情中勇敢追梦。这三位独立的女性，专注于自己的事业，成为职场上的佼佼者。然而在她们坚强的外表下，深藏著对爱情的渴望。尽管在追求梦想的道路上充满坎坷，她们依然坚信自己的抉择。在她们身后都有一位，用自己的方式默默守护的真命天子，以现实的笔触描绘了这三个女性在职场上的竞争和情感中的纠结，将粉红泡泡与现实的辛酸完美结合。

programme.title: 奶酪陷阱
programme.desc: 【金高银与朴海镇领衔，知名主角群展现校园青春浪漫！！】大学新生洪雪面对完美又腹黑的刘正学长，因独特魅力逐渐受他吸引。随著两人情意渐浓，刘正的神秘性个性和控制欲逐渐浮出水面，两人微妙的心理战，以及性格不羁同学的白仁浩再洪雪身边守候，三人的矛盾、最终洪雪情归何处?

programme.title: 韩国小姐(完)
programme.desc: 【2023百想最佳男主角李圣旻社区大叔们联手打造韩国小姐】高中时自恃美貌过人，而没有好好念书的吴智英，毕业后凭借外表当上百货的电梯小姐，看似光鲜亮丽的工作，背后隐藏著许多辛酸，面对毛手毛脚的变态上司，以及百货种种不合理的工作规定，年纪增长且缺乏竞争力另吴智英后悔莫及，偶然的机会下，与现职化妆品公司社长的前男友相遇，公司即将倒闭的金亨俊，与债主郑先生一同把平凡女孩打造为顶级韩国小姐的励志故事。

programme.title: 只属于我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律师劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆袭成知名设计师】恩静与律师姜胜宰结婚后，原以为会享受奢华生活，但现实却是在婆家被当成佣人使唤。婆婆因恩静没有家世而感到丢脸，胜宰也渐渐冷淡，甚至不愿承认老婆。事实上，恩静发现胜宰根本没有办理结婚登记，当她为了帮助妹妹处理财务问题，办理贷款时才揭露了这个真相。不久后她发现老公与BJ集团继承人有染，决心离开伤心地，重返职场成为知名设计师。与此同时，昔日男友俊夏重新进入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能给她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 吹吧微风
programme.desc: 【千亿遗产考验林智妍沦落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一场跨越南北的失散命运，意外揭开千亿财产背后的血缘骗局。脱北女孩微风重返南韩，与多年不见的初恋律师长高重逢，却被卷入豪门争产与身世之谜。冒名孙女设局夺产，谎言层层堆叠，亲情逐渐崩裂；长高的母亲强势介入，以门第与前途逼迫儿子放弃真爱。当真相一一曝光，有人为贪念付出惨痛代价，有人失去一切。被牺牲的爱情，是否还能在命运翻转后，迎来真正的团圆？

programme.desc: 【操纵幻术的魔术师朴海镇×通灵女警秦基周，灵异喜剧Showtime！！】神秘又搞怪的魔术师车次雄，不仅能操纵幻术，还能使唤鬼魂，这群「幽灵助手」是他的得力伙伴。热血女警高瑟海，拥有通灵能力，她对灵异现象毫不畏惧。两人因一起调查超自然案件而结盟，一边与鬼神合作，一边大展魔术与正义力量。当喜剧、灵异与调查结合，爱情与真相也心动牵引。

programme.desc: 【望子成龙！都会家庭的高考大作战】以三个家庭为主轴，方圆和童文洁一家三口，他们的儿子方一凡即将面临高考，但父母的压力与儿子的无忧形成鲜明对比，使得家庭关系逐渐紧张。另一方面，单亲妈妈宋倩与女儿乔英子的生活也充满了挑战，前夫的纠缠和女儿的叛逆让她左右为难。最后，季杨杨从小被寄养在舅舅家，父母突然的关怀让他陷入矛盾，父亲季胜利努力与他建立亲子关系，但结果并不理想。这些家庭的故事交织在一起，展现了现代都市生活中家庭、亲情和成长的种种困境和温暖时刻。

programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋强撩告白高冷花神刘学义，大谈反差萌恋！！】不懂情爱、呆萌率直的小花妖红凝，为了报恩误闯仙界，却意外发现自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身为花神的锦绣。红凝大胆示爱，直言想当锦绣的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡觉就是要陪他洗澡，让这位必须断情绝爱、恪守仙妖界限的未来天帝继承者瞬间乱了方寸。

programme.title: 检索爱情
programme.desc: 【林秀晶X张基龙大谈姐弟恋年下男狂撩职场女强人】聚焦于三位35岁女性——裴朵美、车贤和宋佳景，她们在职场和感情中勇敢追梦。这三位独立的女性，专注于自己的事业，成为职场上的佼佼者。然而在她们坚强的外表下，深藏著对爱情的渴望。尽管在追求梦想的道路上充满坎坷，她们依然坚信自己的抉择。在她们身后都有一位，用自己的方式默默守护的真命天子，以现实的笔触描绘了这三个女性在职场上的竞争和情感中的纠结，将粉红泡泡与现实的辛酸完美结合。

programme.title: 奶酪陷阱
programme.desc: 【金高银与朴海镇领衔，知名主角群展现校园青春浪漫！！】大学新生洪雪面对完美又腹黑的刘正学长，因独特魅力逐渐受他吸引。随著两人情意渐浓，刘正的神秘性个性和控制欲逐渐浮出水面，两人微妙的心理战，以及性格不羁同学的白仁浩再洪雪身边守候，三人的矛盾、最终洪雪情归何处?

programme.title: 暖阳之下
programme.desc: 【温馨陆剧/二宝＆事业该选谁？ 都市夫妻的两难抉择！】宋思凝怀著梦想只身来到北京，经过多年打拼终于成为公司的人力总监，与创意公司总经理李俊龙成为夫妻，并育有一儿，日子过得幸福美满。但在婚育观上，两人的想法有极大的分歧，经常为了女儿的教育问题争吵，李俊龙希望能与思凝生育二宝，然而正值事业上升期的思凝，面临自我实现与家庭的两难冲突，在大都会生活的两人又该如何抉择呢？

programme.title: 只属于我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律师劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆袭成知名设计师】恩静与律师姜胜宰结婚后，原以为会享受奢华生活，但现实却是在婆家被当成佣人使唤。婆婆因恩静没有家世而感到丢脸，胜宰也渐渐冷淡，甚至不愿承认老婆。事实上，恩静发现胜宰根本没有办理结婚登记，当她为了帮助妹妹处理财务问题，办理贷款时才揭露了这个真相。不久后她发现老公与BJ集团继承人有染，决心离开伤心地，重返职场成为知名设计师。与此同时，昔日男友俊夏重新进入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能给她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 吹吧微风
programme.desc: 【千亿遗产考验林智妍沦落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一场跨越南北的失散命运，意外揭开千亿财产背后的血缘骗局。脱北女孩微风重返南韩，与多年不见的初恋律师长高重逢，却被卷入豪门争产与身世之谜。冒名孙女设局夺产，谎言层层堆叠，亲情逐渐崩裂；长高的母亲强势介入，以门第与前途逼迫儿子放弃真爱。当真相一一曝光，有人为贪念付出惨痛代价，有人失去一切。被牺牲的爱情，是否还能在命运翻转后，迎来真正的团圆？

programme.desc: 【操纵幻术的魔术师朴海镇×通灵女警秦基周，灵异喜剧Showtime！！】神秘又搞怪的魔术师车次雄，不仅能操纵幻术，还能使唤鬼魂，这群「幽灵助手」是他的得力伙伴。热血女警高瑟海，拥有通灵能力，她对灵异现象毫不畏惧。两人因一起调查超自然案件而结盟，一边与鬼神合作，一边大展魔术与正义力量。当喜剧、灵异与调查结合，爱情与真相也心动牵引。

programme.title: Baby Einstein - Baby Monet: Discovering the Seasons
programme.desc: As babies grow and change, so does the landscape around them. From fiery red leaves to falling snowflakes; from flowers in bloom to fireworks in July, every season of the year has its own magic just waiting to be discovered. BABY MONET takes little ones on a sight-and-sound-filled journey through spring, summer, fall and winter using puppet shows, images of nature, children, toys, and masterpieces by Claude Monet set to excerpts from composer Antonio Vivaldi's timeless "The Four Seasons."

programme.title: Kids' Planet - Sports - EP119
programme.desc: In this episode, we will travel through the wonderful world of sports. We will learn the physical and mental benefits of practising a sport or physical activity. We will talk about the value of perseverance, training, and the importance of knowing how to win and how to lose. We will learn about different sports and disciplines and how to show respect to our opponents.

Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB

He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SPRING, SUMMER, FALL &amp; WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The rare earth
programme.desc: Along the way, Chip and his friends find an island surrounded by a large lake of acid, under the constant threat of eruption of a volcano. In the island lives lanthanide atoms, according to the legend, are awaiting the arrival of a "chosen" to give them acid that prevents them from leaving the island. Chip, thanks to his book, discovers that the volcano emitted a base when mixed with the acid may neutralize and make the dangerous lake in a nice extension of salt water.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The desert
programme.desc: Across a hot desert Chip and the atoms found themselves with a tungsten atom that gives them refuge under a pyramid-shaped building that, until recently, had an ingenious cooling system through which flowed a stream of ammonia in its basement. But now, Dr. No has diverted the flow of ammonia for his own benefit. Chip discovers the point where ammonia diverts and builds a dam that returns to its normal course.

programme.title: Helen Dorn: The Right To Remain Silent
programme.desc: During a hunting trip, Rolf Kanther, director of a military tech manufacturer, is shot right next to his daughter. Inspector Helen Dorn is sent to investigate the suspicious death, and needs to find out if it's an accident or a calculated murder.

programme.title: Oddball
programme.desc: An eccentric chicken farmer, with the help of his granddaughter, trains his mischievous dog Oddball to protect a penguin sanctuary from fox attacks in an attempt to reunite his family and save their seaside town.

programme.title: Cortina Express
programme.desc: During the Christmas holidays in Cortina, a colorful cast of characters cross paths among the snow-capped Ampezzo mountains. Between love, redemption, and second-chances, their lives collide in a series of hilarious and heartfelt quests for a happy ending

programme.title: Sarah Kohr: Ghost Lights
programme.desc: In a post-pandemic Europe, conspiracy theorist Felix Morgenroth becomes obsessed with exposing the "coronavirus lie." Convinced that physicians Carsten and Lisa Kippmann were behind the conspiracy, Felix seeks retribution through a devastating explosion.

programme.title: Stormskerry Maja
programme.desc: At 17, Maja marries humble fisherman Janne and starts a family on the remote island of Stormskerry, where survival is a constant challenge. Amidst the hardships, Maja awakens to her potential, finding resilience and a love that transcends life and death.

programme.title: Hippocrates
programme.desc: Benjamin dreams of being a great doctor, but his internship at his father’s ward doesn’t turn out the way he hoped. His experience as a junior doctor, with its overwhelming responsibility and stiff competition, forces him to confront his limits and fears.

programme.title: Moon's Walking
programme.desc: On the day of her grandmother’s memorial, 16-year-old Jung-hee escapes a volatile home and goes on a journey in search for the truth behind her grandfather’s disappearance.

programme.title: Until Tomorrow
programme.desc: A single mother's courage is tested when she resorts to desperate measures to hide her illegitimate child from her parents.

programme.title: Sweet Squad
programme.desc: In Kalimantan Barat, teenager Rizal faces a daunting choice to become a sugar courier across the Indonesian-Malaysian border to fund his mother's medical bills. With friends Iwan and Ajung, they risk it all for a chance at saving his mother’s life.

programme.title: Carte Blanche
programme.desc: An uplifting tale of Kacper, a charismatic high school history teacher who hides his progressing blindness from everyone around him to fulfil his educational duties. His methods are unorthodox, sometimes hilarious, and devilishly effective.

programme.desc: Rebellious teen Natsumi ventures from Tokyo to a small island to meet her aunt and learn the art of pearl diving (but secretly to find a treasure she was told about as a child).

programme.desc: To be released from a terrifying voice, Derya must do as it says and follow the one man closest to her, Onur - her boss and childhood friend. Soon enough Derya uncovers some shocking truths about him and is caught up in a dangerous web.

programme.desc: When a heavy summer rain thunders over the Heeler home, Bluey is determined to dam the water in the front yard, while Mum tries to stop her constantly tracking mud into the house.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Shadow Badge
programme.desc: There has been a power cut and the squirrels use their torches to make shadows.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Collecting Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is cleaning his biscuit tin collection, one of the many things he collects. The squirrels are inspired to make their own collections.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Master of Puppets
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, there's a story told in blocks, the tale of a first tooth, a fable about changing emotions, and a yarn involving the Squirrels as puppets.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - The Great Pacific Garbage Patch
programme.desc: When a storm washes up plastic litter onto the Academy beach, the Go Jetters leave Ubercorn, Grandmaster Glitch and the cadets behind and head to the North Pacific Ocean in Jet Pad.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1) - Celery
programme.desc: Live from the Roots &amp; Fruits theatre, it's Celery performing We're Here to Grow - if he manages to squeeze himself out of the dressing room on time.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1) - Plum
programme.desc: Live from the Roots &amp; Fruits theatre, it's Plum performing the Sugar Plum Fairy Bounce and attempting to do not one, not two, but three pirouettes in midair!

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Dino Danger
programme.desc: A toy dinosaur rampages in the Supermarket and scares the Grape Kids. Carrot and Supertato work out that it's controlled by a remote control and get the dinosaur back in its box.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - The Chilli Rocket
programme.desc: Chilli says he's a great skateboarder but when Supertato needs his help, Chilli shows he can't skateboard at all. Chilli turns up the heat and his 'Chilli Rocket' defeats Evil Pea.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Say Hello
programme.desc: Tinky Winky and Laa-Laa are in Home Dome when the Tubby Phone rings. It's Dipsy and Po calling from the Tubby Mobile to say 'Hello'.

programme.title: One Way Only
programme.desc: Danny is a motorbike workshop owner, once was a renowned motorcycle racer, but were seriously injured in an illegal race. Mai, student of Danny, wins a race in Macau under Danny's help. However, because of money and honour, Mai joins illegal races. After knowing this, Li persuades Mai to stop illegal races, but Mai seems cannot find his way out...

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

programme.title: Marco Polo
programme.desc: Mongolian emperor Kublai Khan is being assassinated while meeting with the Italian explorer Marco Polo. Marco Polo is appointed to lead the troops for the emperor to wipe out the anti-Mongol rebels. Yet, he is touched by these rebels who are resisting the Mongolian invasion of their homeland. Will Marco Polo stay loyal to the emperor?

programme.title: The Grand Substitution
programme.desc: In this Opera epic, a loyal Imperial Court servant gives up his own newborn son to save the prince from an evil official.

programme.title: The Fake Ghost Catchers
programme.desc: Huan Zhu's ghost seeks help from "Fake Ghost Catchers" Bao Tuo and Zhou Peng, after a jealous suitor's ghost seeks vengeance by murdering her and now targeting her sister. Together with actor Wu Shun Chao who possesses a supernatural talent, they unite to protect Huan Zhu's sister from both mortal and spectral threats.

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu's enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial arts world, and launches a scheme to pit the various heroes against one another.

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows...

programme.title: Five Shaolin Masters
programme.desc: The Qing court plots to kill all Shaolin disciples by burning down Shaolin Temple. This sudden fire killed almost everyone except for five disciples. To take revenge on the Qing court, the five of them train hard in different fighting styles to become "The Five Shaolin Masters".

programme.title: Lovers Blades
programme.desc: The Lovers Blades, a pair of invincible weapons, are to be delivered to the Qing Emperor. However, they accidentally fell into the hands of Xiao Zhong Hui and Yuan Guan Nan, so Imperial Chief Zhuo Tian Xiong hunts them down for the blades. As the battle begins, the secret of the blades are also revealed.

programme.title: Shaolin Martial Arts
programme.desc: The Qing government assigns fighters to destroy Shaolin Temple and kill all the disciples, but two of them successfully escaped. They train under different masters and learn the Wing Chun and Hung Quan styles respectively, finally killing the fighters and taking revenge for the death of their fellow disciples.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Ping and Su are lovers who operate a travel agency specializing in Southeast Asian holidays. Tung, a school mistress, and her students join a guided tour lead by Ping. During the trip, a spoiled kid Li is attracted to Ping but Su thinks Ping has fallen for Tung and leaves. How will Ping deal with the situation and ends up happily back with Su?

programme.title: The Proud Youth
programme.desc: Ling Hu Chong, a Huashan clan's disciple, is assigned to find the successor to the score "The Proud One". Ling identifies Ying for the score but finds out that she is the daughter of the evil clan's leader. At the same time, he is unwittingly dragged into an epic power struggle between clans, with complicated allegiances and perplexing moralities.

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: The Water Margin
programme.desc: This is a martial arts epic directed by Chang Cheh. In the Sung Dynasty, the government is run by corrupt officials, so Sung Jiang gathers 108 outlaws at Mount Liang and establishes a band of patriotic heroes to end the repression of brutal overlords.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fisherman's honour but accidentally kills the governor's son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the river's edge, he is rescued by the fisherman's daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them, and Tian seals their bond with his family heirloom, the Butterfly Chalice.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s "a-go-go" era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: The Villains
programme.desc: Hung is an orphan seeking help from her wealthy uncle who has two sons but only dotes on the younger son Feng, a playboy. Feng covets the beauty of Hung and rapes her but when she gets pregnant, Hung is wrongfully accused and gets sent off by her uncle to protect Feng. Will Feng be punished for his villainy?

programme.title: Vengeance
programme.desc: Yu Lou is betrayed by his wife and eventually killed by her lover, Fung, who is the boss of a martial arts school. Yu Lou's brother, Xiao Lou, knows about his tragic death and is determined to take revenge for him.

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Wu Song is appointed as chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands when drunk. The wife of his brother Wu Da Lang, seduces Wu Song but gets rejected by him, and engages in an affair with a rich man. They poison Wu Da Lang when he finds out about their affair. To avenge his brother's death, Wu Song kills both of them.

programme.title: A Taste Of Cold Steel
programme.desc: Gan Dai Xiong is killed by Prince Wu, who seeks to seize his Purple Sword. Prince Wu's son join forces with an evil gang to steal the Purple Sword from Gan Dai Xiong's three daughters. Eventually, Gan's daughters team up with their cousin Xu to avenge their father's death.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: Chinatown Kid
programme.desc: After getting into trouble with a local gangster, Chui Ho, in Hong Kong, Tam Dong flees to San Francisco and manages to get a job in a restaurant in Chinatown. Tam Dong finds himself embroiled with the gangsters again in San Francisco, and has to fight Chui Ho when the two meet again...

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun's warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: Danger has Two Faces
programme.desc: Many years ago, Inspector Kam killed an innocent man and decided to resign from the police force. He became a professional killer who disguises as a pet store owner. When his best friend, Bobby begins investigating recent murder cases committed by Kam, he discovers that the mastermind behind these cases is actually his superintendent.

programme.title: Apartment for Ladies
programme.desc: A Taiwanese singer comes to Hong Kong in search for her missing younger sister, who had arrived in Hong Kong to be discovered as a nightclub singer. She finds lodging at an apartment for women run by a man-hating landlady, Mrs Chan. However, Mrs Chan cannot confine the young ladies' youthful vitality within the apartment.

programme.title: Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: The Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung is a group of anti-Ching martial artists who have killed a Ching official. Years later, when five disciples and descendants of Ten Tigers meet one night, one of them is killed by the son of the late Ching official who returns with a vengeance. They must fight against him to protect the Ten Tigers clan...

programme.title: A Friend from Inner Space
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: A Friend from Inner Space
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: Set in the Tang Dynasty, the 13 adopted sons of Sha Tuo King are all renowned as royal warriors. David Chiang plays the 13th Prince, a powerful fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealously, leading to a gruesome family feud.

programme.title: The House of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, deflect targeted harassment by a corrupt policeman and ultimately prevent their home from being sold.

programme.title: The Sword Stained with Royal Blood
programme.desc: Adapted from Jin Yong's novel, the movie depicts the havoc breaking out in the martial arts world when a warrior on the run uncovers a sword, a training manual, a treasure map and a secret message on the body of a deceased martial arts master.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Long's wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident...

programme.title: Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: A Wu Dang disciple Fu, kills the chief of Wu Dang Clan and frames it on the chief's illegitimate child, Yun. Fu then proclaims himself the new chief and orders the killing of Yun, who vows to avenge his father's death and learns the invincible silkworm martial arts style in order to defeat Fu.

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: Fan Jia Shu is a kind-hearted student who is smitten with Shen, a heart-rending love song singer. However, he is not the only one who has eyes for Shen. The General's henchmen are also determined to present the songstress to their superior as a gift. Fan receives help from an unexpected person just in time to save the woman he loves.

programme.title: The Swift Knight
programme.desc: The Ming Emperor is dying with no heir to succeed the throne. His brother recalls that he has an illegitimate child with a court lady years ago and palace guards are sent to search for the heir. When the Emperor's nephew hires assassins to kill the child so he can be the successor, the Swift Knight comes to the rescue...

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, she's soon framed for her husband's murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of her woes in this emotional suspense...

programme.title: The 14 Amazons
programme.desc: The Yang family had served their country in Song Dynasty for generations. When General Yang is ambushed and killed during the war in Jin Shan, the grand matriarch led the entire family to take revenge and defend the country.

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: A sweet inn-keeper's daughter is witness to a perverted rape, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. Can her true love rescue her in time? For this movie, the moonlight serenade is the sound of suspense, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle.

programme.title: Purple Darts
programme.desc: A girl vows to take revenge for her parents who were murdered by four outlaws when she was only a baby. To do so, she trains hard at martial arts and teams up with a swordsman and a couple to finally kill them all.

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer $1M for her baby...

programme.title: The Bells of Death
programme.desc: Wei Fu is an unremarkable woodcutter. However, when psychotic marauders killed his family and abducted his sister, he goes through vigorous martial arts training with an expert swordsman in order to exact revenge on the evildoers.

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei's possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the director's previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killer's claims of an evil spell, then it doesn't let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xin's ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student's family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: Zombie Island
programme.desc: Jeff, a big fan of zombies, goes to a deserted and mysterious island with his friends hoping to seek out exciting adventures. What started as an adventure turns out to be a horrifying journey as they get trapped on the island and are attacked by the zombies! Their lives are in danger when they fail to fight back, and the game has only just begun!

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from real events. Detective Lin sets up a special unit to arrest the motorbike robber and the crime syndicate behind the thefts in Foshan. In the process, his pregnant wife is hit by a motorbike robber, leading him to uncover their revenge plan...

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder happens, and the suspects get killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy over two generations.

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveler
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong's biggest stars

programme.title: Wusong VS Ximenqing
programme.desc: Wu Song finds out about his sister-in-law's affair with a rich man, Ximen Qing. Qing sets Song up and have him exiled for a year, during which his hapless brother is murdered and cremated. When Song finally returns home, he takes the case to court but the judge brushes it aside and closes it abruptly. Can Song finally avenge his brother's death?

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a "super pill" invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B's superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter -the sole witness- mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laika's mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn...

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Conman Sing is forced by a loan shark to team up with another con artist Betty to steal from a luxurious house. When they encounter other conmen who disguise themselves as the house owners to steal the antiques, they pretend to be their rich guests. As both sides know the other's true identity, they join forces to con the loan shark into a trap.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle...

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then...

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister's daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A gambling master and his partner are hired by the government to investigate another gambler who may be working as a Japanese spy in Shanghai.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her father's debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her father's wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao's spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll's eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter's company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the team's downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yip's boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victim's sister takes revenge by spiking the rapist's drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.desc: The core rolling news service of CGTN, with regular updates from Beijing, Washington, Nairobi and London, keep viewers up-to-date with all the world’s top stories as they happen. The World Today delivers breaking news, live events, in-depth reporting, expert analysis and sustained coverage.

programme.title: Razor
programme.desc: CGTN's brand new science and technology show, covering cutting edge developments from all over the world. RAZOR will show you the world's most powerful laser and the world's smallest anti-cancer treatment. It will take you from the weird world of quantum computing to the boundaries of the cosmos. _x000D_An international team of reporters will follow the guidance of Occam's Razor - the principle that the simplest explanation is the best one.

Local correspondents and local production teams provide authoritative and in-depth stories from across the region. Africa Live is an objective and comprehensive look at every facet of African life.
